svg.text: Actual NIFTY index candles | Times IST, start labels | A frozen, B author-corrected, C gap-candle candidate | Ledger overlays only
5-minute: full previous session + full current session
1-minute: first hour; only first five rows form the ORB candle
Opening O 24250.40 H 24266.65 L 24190.00 C 24266.55; body 21.07% | Manual direction / level / entry price UNKNOWN.
Gold band: first 5m. Purple: PDH/PDL. Orange: assumed inner levels. Dashed teal/magenta: assumed LONG/SHORT trendlines. Circles: ledger fills. Crosses: ledger leg exits.
Ledger exits are model fills; on target gaps the existing model keeps the target level, which can lie outside that minute bar.
LONG Method 1: previous_level_close; signed close distance -16.45
LONG Method 2: inner_close; signed close distance -12.45
LONG Gap/200DMA: gap_crossing; signed close distance 158.55
SHORT Method 1: previous_level_close, trend, quality; signed close distance -124.80
SHORT Method 2: inner_close, trend, trendline, quality; signed close distance -15.10
SHORT Gap/200DMA: gap_direction, gap_crossing, ma_close, quality; signed close distance -158.55
